# who.michitai.com — complete reference

Free domain intelligence service by Michitai. Looks up domain registration
(WHOIS/RDAP), live DNS records and IP network intelligence, and keeps an
append-only history of every observed change. Free, no account, no API key.
Copyright (c) 2026 Nichita Levandovici (MICHITAI). All rights reserved.
Contact: support@michitai.com

Base URL: https://who.michitai.com

## Endpoints

### GET /api/lookup/{domain}

Full domain report. `{domain}` may be a Unicode name — it is normalized to
lowercase punycode. Query params: `fresh=1` forces live re-fetch (bypasses cache).

Response 200 — DomainReport:

```json
{
  "domain": "example.com",
  "tld": "com",
  "checkedAt": "2026-10-26T16:21:59.658Z",
  "cached": false,
  "registration": {
    "source": "rdap",
    "server": "https://rdap.verisign.com/com/v1/",
    "domain": "EXAMPLE.COM",
    "registered": true,
    "handle": "2336799_DOMAIN_COM-VRSN",
    "registrar": { "name": "RESERVED-IANA", "ianaId": "376" },
    "statuses": ["client delete prohibited"],
    "events": [
      { "action": "registration", "date": "1995-08-14T04:00:00Z" },
      { "action": "expiration", "date": "2027-08-13T04:00:00Z" }
    ],
    "nameservers": ["a.iana-servers.net", "b.iana-servers.net"],
    "dnssec": "delegationSigned",
    "entities": [{ "roles": ["registrar"], "name": "...", "handle": "..." }]
  },
  "dns": {
    "a": ["23.192.228.80"],
    "aaaa": [],
    "mx": [{ "priority": 0, "exchange": "mail.example.com" }],
    "ns": ["a.iana-servers.net"],
    "cname": [],
    "txt": ["v=spf1 -all"],
    "caa": [],
    "soa": { "nsname": "ns.icann.org", "serial": 2026102601 }
  },
  "ip": {
    "ips": [
      {
        "ip": "23.192.228.80",
        "ptr": "a23-192-228-80.deploy.static.akamaitechnologies.com",
        "network": { "name": "AKAMAI", "org": "Akamai Technologies", "country": "US" },
        "asn": { "asn": 20940, "asName": "AKAMAI-ASN1", "prefix": "23.192.0.0/11" }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

- `registration` is `null` when neither RDAP nor WHOIS has data for the TLD;
  for WHOIS-only TLDs the shape is similar with `source: "whois"`.
- `registered: false` in a registration result means the domain appears available.

### GET /api/lookup/{domain}/history

Snapshot history, newest first. Params: `kind=registration|dns|ip` (optional
filter), `limit` (default 50).

```json
{ "domain": "example.com", "snapshots": [
  { "id": "...", "domainId": "...", "kind": "REGISTRATION",
    "source": "rdap:https://rdap.verisign.com", "payload": { "...": "..." },
    "hash": "sha256…", "fetchedAt": "…", "ttlUntil": "…" }
] }
```

## Caching semantics

- Registration and IP snapshots are fresh for ~24h; DNS for ~30min.
- On re-fetch, an identical payload (sha256 match) extends `ttlUntil` on the
  existing snapshot — history rows therefore represent real changes only.

## Errors

- `400 { "error": "<CODE>", "message": "…" }` — invalid/normalization failure
- `429 { "error": "RATE_LIMITED" }` — over 30 req/min per IP
- `502 { "error": "LOOKUP_FAILED" }` / `HISTORY_FAILED` — upstream unreachable

## Fair use

- 30 requests/minute per IP. `?fresh=1` live re-fetches at most once per
  domain per 5 minutes — a fresh request inside the cooldown serves cache.
- Stored snapshots have registrant contact channels (email/phone/address)
  stripped — history is public registration data only.
